pairs.difference: A: dark purple canopy, near-black on its right side, set on a busy light-grey/white diamond field. Its value grouping looks real-card-like even though the key (0.805) sits just above the real range. B: the fan's mid-grey ribs sit inside a pasted-on white halo that follows its outline. That cut-out glow is the same as the lesson-generated glove's halo.
pairs.fix: Remove the bright white glow hugging the fan's outline; keep the yellow background an even mid-light tone right up to the fan's edge, with only a soft broad light patch behind it.

pairs.difference: A: the sky and sunburst rays go almost pure white over the whole top half, and the overall key (0.792) is above the real range. The mid-grey suitcase sits on a washed-out, near-clipped field. B: the dark chest is grouped against mid-grey flagstones and blue rays, with a clear three-level split.
pairs.fix: Darken the sunburst behind the suitcase to a saturated mid-yellow with visible ray stripes, no near-white sky; keep the brightest tones only on small highlights of the case.

pairs.difference: A: a full stage scene with a dark red backboard, lit bulbs and a black shelf front, broken into clear light, mid and dark groups. B: the envelope is a near-white mass on a lighter circular glow ring, with the green corners going dark (vignette 0.101, above the range). Contrast inside the envelope is flat (rms 0.116, below the range).
pairs.fix: Flatten the green background to one even tone with no light ring behind the envelope and no darkened corners; add firmer shadow under the photo stack and the envelope flap.

pairs.difference: A: the hatbox's black lid and stripes sit on a mid-grey green field with a soft light patch behind and a cast shadow; this is in range. B: a product-photo split into a flat orange wall and a near-white floor. The key (0.762) is above the range and the vignette is slightly negative, with no light/dark structure around the shoes.
pairs.fix: Give the back wall a gentle radial light behind the shoes that falls off toward the corners, and tone the floor down to a warm mid-light, not near-white.

pairs.difference: A: the piano is one near-black mass against a near-white wallpaper wall, with mirror-like reflections on the floor. The hero-to-ground gap (-0.33) and contrast (0.223) are both beyond the real range. B: the guitar sits on a mid-value stage, with its spotlight beams as light groups.
pairs.fix: Lighten the piano body to a warm mid-brown with visible lit faces on the lid and front panel, and calm the wall to a mid-light cream so the piano is not a black silhouette.

pairs.difference: A: the card is split into two flat blocks, a near-black purple wall behind a near-white tablecloth. The white cake stand merges with the cloth, with no value separation. The gap (0.209), contrast (0.221) and inverted vignette (-0.101) are all out of range. B: the fountain is uniformly light-mid with soft contrast. Its key is a little high, but the groups are coherent.
pairs.fix: Lighten the purple wall to a mid-tone with soft stripes, and tint the tablecloth darker lilac so the white stand reads brighter than the cloth beneath it.

pairs.difference: A: a near-black glossy cup with a light glow behind it and slightly darker corners. B: a dark-blue machine with a light glass panel and a soft glow behind it. Both fall inside the real ranges, and both use the dark-hero-on-lit-ground layout seen in the real cards.

A: the gold watch is light-mid, with a white face on mid-grey diamonds. It is low contrast (0.098) but in range. B: the ring box is a near-black frame inside a bright white burst glow, and the corners go dark (vignette 0.162, above the range). This is the lesson-generated halo-plus-black-accent layout.
pairs.fix: Remove the bright glow ring behind the box and keep the sunburst rays an even mid-blue to the corners; lift the red box's shadow side so it is dark red, not black.

pairs.difference: A: the top hat is a huge near-black mass with only thin highlights, on a light circular glow. The gap (-0.45) and contrast (0.225) are far outside the real range. B: the graduation cap is also dark on a glow circle, but its gap (-0.312) is milder and a gold band breaks up the dark mass.
pairs.fix: Lighten the hat to a deep charcoal-blue with broad soft sheen across the crown and brim, so it is not a solid black shape against the bright ring.

pairs.difference: A: a red fan in mid-dark tones on mid-light wavy blue, with an even key. B: a red scarf with a near-black inner collar on a light swirl centre, with darker edges (vignette 0.115, in range). Both match the real groupings.

A: the rocking chair is mid-light against a darker striped blue wall, on a light floor, with all three value groups present and in range. B: a near-white feather is set against a white glow patch on the yellow wall, above a near-black ink bottle. The key (0.774) is above the range, and the hard white/black pairing sits at the centre.
pairs.fix: Remove the white glow behind the feather; tone the feather to a warm cream with soft grey shading, and lift the ink bottle to a deep green with visible glass highlights, not a black blob.

pairs.difference: A: the red bus is a dark-mid mass against a light sky and buildings, with good local contrast (0.172). B: the ice-cream sign is mostly mid-grey on a mid-grey green wall, with only the neon outline light. Contrast (0.098) is below the real range, so the card reads flat and the hero is separated almost only by hue.
pairs.fix: Make the cone and scoop clearly lighter than the green wall, with a bright lit top on the scoop and a darker shadowed underside, and darken the wall slightly toward the edges.

pattern: Generated cards push values to extremes that the real cards avoid. Heroes go near-black against near-white or glowing grounds, which gives out-of-range hero gaps and contrast. A pasted-on bright halo hugs the hero's outline, sometimes with darkened corners. Alternatively, the whole card goes washed-out high-key or flat mid-grey, with no three-level grouping. Real cards keep the hero mid-dark on an even mid-light ground and reserve black for small accents.
